question: Excluding the stoppages, the speed of a bus is 80 km/h and including the stoppages, the speed of the bus is 52 km/h. How many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the bus excluding stoppages = 80 km/h

Speed of the bus including stoppages = 52 km/h

We need to find how many minutes the bus stops per hour.

**Formula used:**

Time stopped per hour = dfrac{{Time difference}}{{Total time in hour}} × 60 (to convert hours to minutes)

Distance traveled per hour (excluding stoppages) = 80 km

Distance traveled per hour (including stoppages) = 52 km

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Calculate the distance not traveled due to stoppages.

⇒ Distance not traveled = 80 km - 52 km = 28 km

Step 2: Time taken to cover 28 km at the speed of 80 km/h:

⇒ Time stopped = 2880" id="MathJax-Element-33-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">2880 2880 \dfrac{28}{80} hours

⇒ Time stopped = 0.35 hours

Step 3: Convert time stopped to minutes.

⇒ Time stopped in minutes = 0.35 × 60 = 21 minutes

**∴ The bus stops for 21 minutes per hour.**
